core_obligations: Section test: it suffices to show the canonical map from the colimit to f_!F is a bijection on sections over quasi-compact objects V of Y_etale (proof lines 940-942).
Directed colimit: the colimit is directed with injective transition maps (from the directedness of the covering), so the directed colimits sections lemma evaluates it (proof lines 943-947).
Covering observation: the statement reduces to the observation that a closed subset Z of X_V proper over V is quasi-compact and hence contained in X_{i,V} for some i (proof lines 947-949).
